## THROWAWAY DIAGNOSTIC
Every Sheets node in RE-00 is set to continue-on-error, so a rejected write still looks green. Nothing here suppresses anything.

1. Import this
2. Attach your Google Sheets credential to both Sheets nodes
3. Hit 'Execute workflow'

It will either write a row named DIAGNOSTIC TEST to your Leads tab, or fail with the real reason in red.

Delete this workflow afterwards.

nodes.name: 1 - Read Leads Tab
nodes.notes: Proves the credential, the document ID and the tab name. If this fails, the write was never going to work.

nodes.name: 2 - Inspect Headers
nodes.notes: Open this node's OUTPUT and read __diagnostic.verdict before anything else.

nodes.name: 3 - Write Test Row
nodes.notes: Exactly the operation Save Lead to CRM performs, with NO onError setting - so any rejection shows in red instead of passing silently.
